evidence.source_assertion: Icom identifies BP-210N as its Ni-MH battery pack with 7.2 V, 1480 mAh minimum and 1650 mAh typical capacity.
Icom identifies BP-234 as a non-rechargeable lithium battery pack rated 9.0 V and 3300 mAh.
evidence.conflict_reason: Legacy title says rechargeable Li-ion and 7.2 V; the official page says non-rechargeable lithium and 9.0 V.

evidence.source_assertion: Icom identifies BP-252 as a 7.2 V Li-ion battery pack with 1000 mAh minimum and 1050 mAh typical capacity.
evidence.conflict_reason: Legacy 980 mAh capacity conflicts with the official minimum and typical ratings.

evidence.source_assertion: Icom identifies BP-256 as a 7.4 V Li-ion battery pack with 1620 mAh minimum and 1700 mAh typical capacity.
evidence.conflict_reason: Legacy 7.2 V conflicts with the official 7.4 V rating.

evidence.source_assertion: Icom identifies BP-264 as its 7.2 V 1400 mAh Ni-MH battery pack.
Baofeng's product page describes an original 1800 mAh battery compatible with UV-5R, but the legacy title provides no stable battery MPN.
evidence.conflict_reason: Compatibility and capacity do not establish a bounded battery MPN for the offered pack.
